1 
Bill 9 
BILL 9
2025 
PROTECTING ALBERTA’S 
CHILDREN STATUTES  
AMENDMENT ACT, 2025 
(Assented to , 2025) 
HIS MAJESTY, by and with the advice and consent of the 
Legislative Assembly of Alberta, enacts as follows: 
Education Act 
Amends SA 2012 cE-0.3 
1(1)  The Education Act is amended by this section. 
(2) The following is added after section 58.12:
Declaration re Charter, Bill of Rights and Human Rights Act 
58.13   Sections 18(1)(d.1) and (d.2), 18.1, 33.2, 58.11 and 58.12 
shall operate notwithstanding  
(a) sections 2 and 7 to 15 of the Canadian Charter of Rights
and Freedoms,
(b) the Alberta Bill of Rights, and
(c) the Alberta Human Rights Act.
Fairness and Safety in Sport Act 
Amends SA 2024 cF-2.5 
2(1)  The Fairness and Safety in Sport Act is amended by this 
section.
 1 Explanatory Notes  
Explanatory Notes 
Education Act 
1(1)   Amends chapter E-0.3 of the Statutes of Alberta, 2012. 
(2)   Declaration re Charter, Bill of Rights and Human Rights Act. 
Fairness and Safety in Sport Act 
2(1)   Amends chapter F-2.5 of the Statutes of Alberta, 2024. 
  
 
 2 
(2)  The following is added after section 7: 
Declaration re Charter, Bill of Rights and Human Rights Act 
7.1(1)  This Act shall operate notwithstanding  
 (a) sections 2 and 7 to 15 of the Canadian Charter of Rights 
and Freedoms,  
 (b) the Alberta Bill of Rights, and 
 (c) the Alberta Human Rights Act. 
(2)  A regulation made under this Act, including the Fairness and 
Safety in Sport Regulation (AR 124/2025), is deemed to be a 
provision of this Act. 
(3)  For greater certainty, subsection (1) applies to a regulation 
made under this Act, including the Fairness and Safety in Sport 
Regulation (AR 124/2025).  
Health Professions Act 
Amends RSA 2000 cH-7 
3(1)  The Health Professions Act is amended by this section. 
(2)  The following is added after section 1.94: 
Declaration re Charter, Bill of Rights and Human Rights Act 
1.95(1)  Sections 1.91, 1.92 and 1.93 shall operate 
notwithstanding  
 (a) sections 2 and 7 to 15 of the Canadian Charter of Rights 
and Freedoms,  
 (b) the Alberta Bill of Rights, and 
 (c) the Alberta Human Rights Act. 
(2)  A regulation made under section 1.92(2) of this Act is 
deemed to be a provision of this Act. 
(3)  An order made under section 1.93 of this Act, including 
Ministerial Order No. 31/2025 made by the Minister of Primary 
and Preventative Health Services, is deemed to be a provision of 
this Act.
 2 Explanatory Notes  
(2)   Declaration re Charter, Bill of Rights and Human Rights Act. 
Health Professions Act 
3(1)   Amends chapter H-7 of the Revised Statutes of Alberta 2000. 
(2)   Declaration re Charter, Bill of Rights and Human Rights Act. 
  
 
 3 
(4)  For greater certainty, subsection (1) applies to  
 (a) a regulation made under section 1.92(2) of this Act, and  
 (b) an order made under section 1.93 of this Act, including 
Ministerial Order No. 31/2025 made by the Minister 
of Primary and Preventative Health Services. 
 
 
 3 Explanatory Notes
